correctness.rationale: Unique interior state follows monotone p-dependent gain. Strict convex f in x for N>=3 at the equality return yields positive equilibrium trace and a strictly positive Dulac divergence everywhere in the simply connected open square. Bendixson-Dulac excludes closed orbits; planar omega-limit alternatives and the unique hyperbolic source force boundary liminf zero for every other trajectory. For N=2, explicit coercive separated first integral yields a foliation by periodic regular level curves. Rational N=2/N=3 Jacobians and symbolic derivatives verified in the included checker; finite tests do not prove global assertions.

value.rationale: In the motivating higher-order social-dilemma model the phase line r=N separates conventional selection regimes but has a nonhyperbolic boundary. This theorem resolves its long-time interior recurrence at equality for every interaction size, proves no sustained interior cycling for any N>=3 even though equilibrium repels, and shows the sharp pairwise contrast where every nonstationary interior state cycles. This affects interpretation of long-lived eco-evolutionary oscillations at the exact cooperation threshold.
